{"items": ["[passage_read_so_far]
- Utterson and Enfield stop before the by-street door on their Sunday walk.（Mr. Utterson、Mr. Richard Enfield）
- Enfield says the Hyde story is at an end and they will never see Hyde again.（Mr. Richard Enfield）
- Utterson admits he once saw Hyde and shared Enfield's repulsion.（Mr. Utterson）
- Enfield reveals he learned the door was a back way to Dr. Jekyll's.（Mr. Richard Enfield）
- They enter the court to look at the windows, Utterson uneasy about Jekyll.（Mr. Utterson、Mr. Richard Enfield）
- Utterson sees Dr. Jekyll sitting sadly at the middle window.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Utterson greets Jekyll and hopes he is better.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll replies he is very low and says it will not last long.（Dr. Jekyll）
- Utterson introduces his cousin Mr. Enfield to Dr. Jekyll and invites Jekyll out.（Mr. Utterson、Mr. Richard Enfield、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll declines the walk, saying it is quite impossible and he dare not.（Dr. Jekyll）
- Utterson proposes they stay below and talk from where they are.（Mr. Utterson、Dr. Jekyll）
- Jekyll's smile turns to abject terror and the window is thrust down.（Dr. Jekyll）
- The two men leave the court in silence, pale with horror.（Mr. Utterson、Mr. Richard Enfield）
- Utterson says 'God forgive us' twice.（Mr. Utterson）

Enfield reveals the door is Dr. Jekyll's back way. Looking up, Utterson sees Jekyll sadly at the middle window. Jekyll says he is very low and it will not last long. He declines their walk, saying he dare not. When Utterson suggests talking from below, Jekyll's smile becomes abject terror and the window is thrust down.
